# TDPdf v1.29.5.0

**Text you place can now be set in a different font — and a quiet bug in Clone() that could lose bold/italic/underline on undo is fixed alongside it.**

## Pick a font

Placed text and Edit Existing Text were always drawn in one fixed system font, with no way to change it. The style bar (visible while a text tool is active, or a text annotation is selected) now has a "Font:" dropdown next to Size.

The list is deliberately short rather than every font installed on your machine: the previous default, Arial, Times New Roman, Courier New, and Calibri. Every one of those is already a known-good match in TDPdf's own font-resolution logic, so nothing on the list can fail to embed correctly in the saved PDF, and — just as importantly — it's guaranteed to still be there if someone else opens the same file on a different computer. A colour dropper for matching an existing color already exists too, by the way: open the color swatches in the same style bar and click the custom-color option — there's an eyedropper button in that dialog.

## A small correctness fix found along the way

While wiring the new font field into `TextAnnotation`, a pre-existing bug turned up: `Clone()` — used by undo/redo to snapshot annotations before a change — wasn't copying Bold, Italic, or Underline. Fixed at the same time.
